name: Ruou can
summary: Rượu cần is a Bru–Vân Kiều drink for community rites and festivals, and Chứt villages drink it too.
origin: Bru–Vân Kiều and Chứt villages in the Phong Nha-Ke Bang buffer.
culture: It belongs to Bru–Vân Kiều community life, rites, and festivals, and the new-rice festival is one of those occasions.
howToEat: Drink it in the villages, at a rite or a festival.
where: Bru–Vân Kiều and Chứt villages in the buffer.
seoTitle: Ruou can — buffer jar wine at Phong Nha
seoDescription: Rượu cần is a Bru–Vân Kiều festival drink in the villages around Phong Nha-Ke Bang, also drunk in Chứt villages.
